definition: אַפֶּ֫דֶן noun [masculine] palace (Syriac ; both from Persian apadâna compare Spieg Altpers. Keilschr. 128 , but this = treasury, armoury , M. Schultze ZMG 1885, 48 f ** Dieulafoy RÉJ xvi {1888}, p. cclxxvf. makes apadâna , more precisely, throneroom , compare Dr Du 11, 45 .) אָהֳלֵי אַפַּדְֿנוֺ Dan 11:45 of the 'king of the north', i.e. Antiochus Epiphanes.
